results.name: Cable Assisted Inverse Leg Curl
instructions: Kneel on the seat of a cable pulldown machine with both legs secured under the thigh pads. Face away from the machine and hold the cable bar behind your neck with both hands.
Lean forward to straighten your legs until your torso is almost parallel to the floor.
Slowly return to the starting position by bringing your upper body back up, bending at the knees.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and reduce the risk of injury.
Avoid using momentum; focus on the controlled contraction of your hamstrings.
Exhale as you straighten your legs and inhale as you return to the starting position.
results.description: Cable Assisted Inverse Leg Curl is a beginner single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Lower Back, Abdominals.

results.name: Cable Calve Raise
instructions: Stand facing a low cable pulley with a straight bar attachment, with your feet hip-width apart, holding the bar in front of your hips with both hands.
Push through your forefeet to raise your heels as high as possible.
Pause for a second at the peak of the movement and then slowly lower your heels back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired repetitions.
tips: Focus on moving only at the ankles to isolate your calves.
Keep your knees slightly bent and avoid locking them out to minimize knee stress.
Hold the top position for a second to maximize contraction.
results.description: Cable Calve Raise is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shins.

results.name: Cable Goblet Squat
instructions: Stand upright facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a bar attachment with both hands at chest level with elbows facing the floor.
Begin squatting by bending your hips and knees, descend into a deep squat until your thighs are parallel to the ground or lower.
Push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired repetitions.
tips: Keep your elbows pointed down and tucked in to stabilize the bar during the squat.
Engage your core to protect your lower back and maintain balance.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes as you descend.
results.description: Cable Goblet Squat is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves, Lower Back.

results.name: Cable Hamstring Curl
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and secure it around your working ankle, then stand upright facing the machine and hold onto a stable surface or clasp your hands together for balance.
Keep your upper body stationary and your knees aligned as you slowly bend your working knee, curling your foot up toward your glutes.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement, focusing on squeezing your hamstring.
Lower your foot back down to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
tips: Squeeze your hamstring at the top of the curl for peak contraction.
Adjust the weight appropriately to maintain proper form throughout the set.
Maintain a slight bend in your standing leg for better stability.
results.description: Cable Hamstring Curl is a beginner single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Calves.

results.name: Cable Individual Glute Kickbacks
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley on a cable machine and secure it around one ankle. Stand facing the machine and hold onto the handles or frame for support while keeping your torso leaning slightly forward.
Engage your core and shift your weight onto the stationary leg while slightly bending the knee of the supporting leg.
Extend the strapped leg straight back in a controlled motion, squeezing your glute at the top without hyperextending your lower back.
Slowly return your leg to the starting position without letting the weight stack touch, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.
tips: Perform each repetition with slow and controlled motion to maximize glute engagement.
Avoid swinging your leg or using momentum to lift the weight.
Focus on squeezing the glute at the top of the movement for better muscle activation.
results.description: Cable Individual Glute Kickbacks is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Lower Back.

results.name: Cable Narrow Chair Stand-Up
instructions: Attach a rope to the low pulley on the machine. Grasp the end of the rope in each hand and bring it close to your chest.Feet close together, flat on the floor, knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Push through your heels and extend your legs to stand up, keeping the handles close to your chest.
Slowly lower yourself back down to the seated position, controlling the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Focus on pushing through your heels to engage your glutes and quads effectively.
Exhale as you stand up and inhale as you sit back down.
Ensure your back remains straight and avoid rounding your spine.
results.description: Cable Narrow Chair Stand-Up is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Core.

results.name: Cable Pull Through
instructions: Stand in the middle of a cable pulley machine with a rope attached at a low position. Hold the handles between your thighs with your back facing the machine, and the cables extending back.
Spread your feet just wider than shoulder-width, lean forward, bending at the hips and knees into a semi-squat position, while keeping your back straight and your arms extended.
Extend your hips forward to straighten your body, pushing the handles with your thighs.
Return to the starting semi-squat position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid using your lower back to lift; the movement should come from your hips.
Focus on engaging your glutes and hamstrings as you extend your hips.
Exhale as you extend your hips forward and inhale as you return to the starting position.
results.description: Cable Pull Through is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back, Core.

results.name: Cable Single Leg Deadlift
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and stand facing the cable while holding the bar with both hands. Shift your weight onto your right leg, keeping it bent at 90 degrees.
Slightly bend your standing knee and hinge at the hips to lower your torso to the floor.
Once your torso is nearly parallel to the floor. Drive through your standing leg to return to the starting position
Lower your foot to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired repetitions, switch legs, and repeat.
tips: Maintain a neutral spine throughout the entire movement to avoid lower back strain.
Keep your hips square to the floor and avoid rotating your torso as you hinge forward.
Engage your core to help stabilize your balance during the single-leg movement.
results.description: Cable Single Leg Deadlift is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back, Abdominals.

results.name: Cable Split Squat
instructions: Stand in front of a low pulley cable machine with a bar attached and grab it with both hands using an overhand grip. Take a step back into a split stance with one foot forward and one foot behind.
Hold the bar extended along the cable and keep your torso upright.
Lower your body by bending both knees until your thigh is parallel to the floor. Push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired repetitions.
tips: Keep your front knee aligned with your ankle throughout the movement.
Lower yourself slowly to avoid unnecessary strain on the knee joint.
Avoid locking out the knees at the top to keep muscles under tension.
results.description: Cable Split Squat is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings.

results.name: Calf Raise Clap
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended out to the sides at shoulder level.
Lift your heels off the floor as high as possible while simultaneously bringing your arms forward to clap, keeping them straight.
Lower your heels back to the floor and return your arms to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your head up and eyes forward to maintain proper alignment and balance.
Squeeze your calf muscles fully at the top of the movement for maximum benefit.
Focus on keeping your arms straight and level with your shoulders throughout the exercise to maintain proper form.
results.description: Calf Raise Clap is an advanced single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the plyometric category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Shoulders.
